text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Cheval Grand had achieved 
the Classic Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ………………Um... er, excuse me...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe♪ Ready, and—

text_block_list.name: Crown & Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on winning the Triple Crown, 
Cheval! Congrats on the Triple Crown, 
Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fuhya?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, this... Wh-What's going on...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, were you surprised? Then it was a 
huge success♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In the Kikuka Sho the other day, you 
finally achieved the Triple Crown, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho and Japan Derby were super 
frustrating, but... that was then, and 
this is now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's my sworn friend's great achievement, 
after all! I wanted to celebrate it 
properly♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I was thinking of gathering a 
whole bunch more people and turning it 
into a real festival, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We thought it might be too overwhelming 
otherwise. So it's just the two of us to 
start with!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's amazing~ To think a Triple 
Crown Umamusume would come from our 
generation!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Speed, skills, stamina. I 
must possess them all, honed to 
perfection—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Without that, you couldn't have achieved 
such a great feat. It's truly a 
magnificent accomplishment, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aha, are you totally blushing, 
Cheval-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, it really is 
incredible! Don't be shy, let everyone 
give you a massive celebration!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……! ……Th-Thank you……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like... I'm dreaming... Me... 
winning the Triple Crown...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Butterfly Dream of Zhuang Zhou? 
Fufu, assuming this is a dream, I wonder 
how long Cheval has been dreaming it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: B-Before the Make Debut... or something.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
M-M-Maybe everything since passing the 
Tracen Academy entrance exam has all been 
a d-d-dream...
—...I can't have this be just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Du... Duramente-san...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, my motivation is sustained by 
the goal of healing my injury and 
challenging you once more."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat you and prove to the world 
who is the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason as well, I need you to be 
even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……! Ugh…… Y-…… Yes!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'm counting on you. ...Ah, and also—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ......Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good for you, Cheval. ...Though I'm 
just a little jealous.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's not just Duramente-san! I'll do my 
best to beat you too, Cheval-chan, so 
let's run together again!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo. Is Cheval-chi super popular with 
the crowd or what?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, seeing you happy makes me happy♪ Hey, 
hey, Onee-chan! Why don't we join in the 
celebration too?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, Vivlos—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's save the celebration for later. We 
can always celebrate for her at home, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, is that so...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then I'll ask Papa to get us a cake! 
One big enough to totally hide Cheval-chi 
behind!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A-And, we'll line up tons of Cheval-chi's 
favorite foods too! Ehehe, we're gonna 
make it a super fancy celebrity party!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(To think... so many would celebrate for 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The Triple Crown... I'm so glad I gave it 
my all...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, lively chatter filled the 
cafeteria for a while.
